R108 profiles() tells each layer of the chain: level, place, origin, coverage and the number of facts it gives, with the layer it sits within, in level order; view.layers as combine gives them; control: an empty chain answers no active profile

R109 a place is named as a set of names, each a state, a county or a city; a layer arriving in an update whose place or covers matches a name is told once as an arrival, saying the team's own entries stay; control: a layer already active is not an arrival
R111 an update changes no choice: a copy with oakland-alameda recorded answers profiles() with the four layers, and its setting is the same string, never rewritten at a later start

R112 after the split, officesSeed on the package's layer writes no line and no entity the package's seeding wrote and answers each already; a line is found by its kind and its two ends under any profile key (control: a new layer's offices are seeded once, each office recording its layer)

R113 a copy active on oakland-alameda, updated to the layered release, answers placeArrivals with []: the last-compared set and the active ids are read as layers (control: a layer arriving that matches the named place and is in no active package is one arrival, answered with its layer)
